elements.element: The obligations are triggered by expiry or termination of the agreement.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) applies “Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor must provide post-termination transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Licensor must, at Licensee’s request, “provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The assistance is available “for a period of up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at Vendor's then-current rates.
Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Licensor must return to Licensee all defined “Licensee Data,” covering Licensee and customer data stored in or processed by the Licensed Technology.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Return is required “within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The required format is “a commonly used, machine-readable format,” which substantively satisfies the standard machine-readable requirement.

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after the return.
elements.evidence: Subsection (iii) requires Licensor to “thereafter delete Licensee Data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor must certify the deletion after it occurs.
elements.evidence: Licensor must “certify such deletion to Licensee in writing” after deletion.

elements.element: The obligations are triggered by expiry or termination of the agreement.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) applies upon either expiration or termination for any reason.

elements.element: Vendor must provide post-termination transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Licensor is expressly obligated to provide reasonable transition assistance at Licensee’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: Assistance is available for up to six months, which includes and exceeds a requested 90-day period.

elements.element: Vendor must export Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Licensor must return all defined Licensee Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format, constituting a data export.

elements.element: The data export must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The return/export deadline is thirty days after expiration or termination.

result.reason: The added subsection satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also the fallback. It imposes the correct duties on Licensor, covers both expiration and termination, provides six months of assistance at then-current rates, requires a machine-readable data return within 30 days, and requires subsequent deletion and written certification. The request condition is a customary activation mechanism controlled by Licensee and does not prevent Licensee from obtaining the full assistance period. The amendment is confined to transition and data-return mechanics and does not disturb the original return-of-materials obligations. Drafting quality is reduced by ambiguities such as “reasonable” assistance, no fixed deadline for deletion or certification, and the pre-existing grammatical and punctuation defects left in the article.
